name: lanzate-theme
title: Lanzate Theme
description: Design tokens shared by every Lanzate UI component. Generated from tokens/; do not edit by hand.

files.content:
// Generated by tooling/tokens/build.js from tokens/. Do not edit; run `bun run tokens`.

export type ColorToken = "primary" | "primary-foreground" | "primary-text" | "error" | "error-foreground" | "error-text" | "info" | "info-foreground" | "info-text" | "warning" | "warning-foreground" | "warning-text" | "success" | "success-foreground" | "success-text" | "secondary-text" | "muted-text" | "background" | "foreground" | "card" | "card-foreground" | "popover" | "popover-foreground" | "secondary" | "secondary-foreground" | "muted" | "muted-foreground" | "accent" | "accent-foreground" | "destructive" | "border" | "input" | "ring" | "brand" | "brand-foreground" | "chart-1" | "chart-2" | "chart-3" | "chart-4" | "chart-5" | "sidebar" | "sidebar-foreground" | "sidebar-primary" | "sidebar-primary-foreground" | "sidebar-accent" | "sidebar-accent-foreground" | "sidebar-border" | "sidebar-ring" | "hero-glow"
export type IntentColor = "primary" | "error" | "info" | "warning" | "success" | "secondary" | "muted"
export type TextSize = "3xs" | "2xs" | "xs" | "sm" | "base" | "lg" | "xl" | "2xl" | "display" | "hero"
export type Radius = "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "2xl" | "3xl" | "4xl"
export type Shadow = "elevated" | "elevated-hover" | "elevated-active" | "button-glow" | "button-glow-hover" | "button-glow-active" | "button-surface" | "button-surface-active" | "soft" | "pop" | "floating"
export type Ease = "spring"
export type FontFamily = "heading" | "sans" | "mono" | "serif"
export type ThemeName = "ocean" | "sunset"

theme.shadow-button-glow: 0 0 8px 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--btn-color) 50%, transparent), 0 0 24px 6px color-mix(in oklch, var(--btn-color) 22%, transparent)
theme.shadow-button-glow-hover: 0 0 12px 4px color-mix(in oklch, var(--btn-color) 65%, transparent), 0 0 36px 10px color-mix(in oklch, var(--btn-color) 30%, transparent)
theme.shadow-button-glow-active: 0 0 5px 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--btn-color) 40%, transparent), 0 0 14px 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--btn-color) 18%, transparent)
theme.shadow-button-surface: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.35), inset 0 -1px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.25), inset 1px 0 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.15), inset -1px 0 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.12)
